name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is only a restriction ('Don't drop the key while the door is still closed') and commands no event, so the rule-only warning is valid. key_lost is defined as the key being acquired and then lost while door_open is false, so the 'while the door is still closed' condition is already built into the event; the prescribed ban is a plain hard Absence(key_lost), not a Precedence. It is breakable in this environment (dropping the key to pick up the ball fires key_lost while the door is closed) and dropping after the door opens correctly stays allowed.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
